title: A Local Agentic AI Framework to Generate Edge Case Scenarios for Safety Assurance
title_zh: 一种用于生成边缘案例场景以保障安全的本地智能体人工智能框架

paragraphs.en: Generating edge case scenarios is crucial for training, testing and safety assuring autonomous systems. This identifies hazardous failures to increase system reliability and robustness, ensures the system can still function safely on the boundaries of its operational design domain and learns the expected system behaviour for these edge cases. The rapid advancement in the generation and analysis capabilities of language models (LMs) has expanded their applicability and recent work has investigated LM scenario generation. However, many recent approaches rely on human-in-the-loop or rule-based strategies. This restricts the LM’s ability to generate diverse and edge case scenarios; the long tail of the distribution. Our work uses local LMs in a laptop-based agentic AI framework for adaptive scenario generation. This is cheap, fully-controlled, ensures data privacy and security. It uses think, act, observe, update, and continue loops with lightweight JSON encoding to generate scenarios. We use the system requirements, system description and environment description as knowledge bases in contextual prompts for an LM to ensure scenario realism. A second, independent LM critiques each scenario using domain specific criteria so it can be refined. The refined scenarios are run in simulation and evaluation metrics collected. These metric scores are analysed and similar scenarios are created for edge cases (exploitation) or novel scenarios are generated to explore the scenario space. Post-hoc clustering using metric scores and thematic-type analysis of the rich-text scenario descriptions produced by the LM pinpoints functional gaps and their triggering conditions. This creates traceable evidence for the safety assurance case. Our work highlights the potential of a flexible and adaptive local agentic AI framework for automating edge case generation and producing traceable safety assurance evidence.

paragraphs.en: The impact of recent innovations in AI systems has changed how businesses and even economies function and changed how people interact with their environment. The emergence of AI-based autonomous systems is a major part of this innovation. An autonomous system is: “ a system involving software applications, machines, and people, that is able to take actions with little or no human supervision ’’ 1 1 1 https://tas.ac.uk/our-definitions/ (accessed 27 Sept 2026) . These systems have the potential to revolutionise daily life and their use is expanding rapidly, in particular in safety-critical domains. Safety-critical domains include autonomous road vehicles; medical, assistive, manufacturing and delivery robots; aerial vehicles; marine vehicles; underwater vehicles; wireless sensor networks used for monitoring; and components within systems such as an autopilot system in an aircraft [ 1 ] .

paragraphs.en: The development of autonomous systems that operate in safety-critical domains remains complex. Failures in such systems can cause harm to the environment, harm to people, or substantial economic loss [ 2 ] . As systems become more autonomous, the level of human oversight decreases [ 3 ] . Replacing humans with AI in these systems means that we can no longer rely on a suitably qualified human to respond to unusual situations in a safe manner. Instead, we are required to argue that, throughout its operational lifetime, the system will, autonomously, meet operational, safety, and regulatory standards under all anticipated operating conditions. However, such safety assurance requires rigorous and often expensive through-life safety assurance processes to ensure safety standards and regulations are met, and that the system is free from unacceptable risks. Autonomous systems that operate in open-world environments shift the focus of safe development and operation from guaranteeing against known operational parameters to effectively anticipating and mitigating novel inputs, unexpected situations and uncertainty. Furthermore, the system’s operational environment may be underspecified at design time [ 3 ] , or even unknown, which further increases the likelihood of unknown and unsafe scenarios. Arguing that the system is free from unacceptable risk is a complex and multifaceted process.
paragraphs.zh: 在安全关键领域运行的自主系统的开发仍然十分复杂。 此类系统的故障可能对环境造成危害、对人员造成伤害，或导致巨大的经济损失 [ 2 ] 。 随着系统自主性程度的提高，人类监督的级别也随之降低 [ 3 ] 。 在这些系统中用人工智能取代人类意味着我们再也无法依赖具备适当资质的专业人员以安全的方式应对异常情况。 相反，我们必须论证该系统在其整个运行生命周期内，都能在所有预期的运行条件下自主满足操作、安全和监管标准。 然而，要实现这样的安全保障，需要严格且通常成本高昂的全生命周期安全保证流程，以确保符合安全标准和法规，并保证系统不存在不可接受的风险。 在开放世界环境中运行的自主系统将安全开发与运营的重点从确保已知运行参数内的可靠性，转向有效预测和缓解新型输入、意外情况以及不确定性。 此外，系统运行环境在设计阶段可能未被充分定义 [ 3 ] ，甚至完全未知，这进一步增加了出现未知且不安全场景的可能性。 论证该系统不存在不可接受的风险是一个复杂且多维度的过程。

paragraphs.en: The required safety guarantees on the autonomous system that must be evidenced to argue its safety can be represented as g ⁡ ( 𝐀𝐒 ) g(\mathbf{AS}) and include requirements such as minimum obstacle clearance, minimum safe lighting level, or task completion time limits. An operational design domain (ODD) specifies this operational environment within which an autonomous system is intended to operate reliably and safely. The ODD effectively defines the parameters for system testing [ 4 ] . Systematic and comprehensive testing throughout development and operation is vital for ensuring the system will operate reliably and safely within its ODD. Scenario-based testing tests systems against meaningful scenarios and can be used during training and verification and validation of AI models to ensure robustness and provide evidence that g ⁡ ( 𝐀𝐒 ) g(\mathbf{AS}) will be met. There are three levels of scenarios for safety assurance testing in decreasing level of abstraction: functional (linguistic description), logical (range and distribution of parameters), and concrete [ 5 , 6 ] . Concrete scenarios θ \theta are sampled from the logical scenario distribution Θ \Theta and specify a value for each parameter. These concrete scenarios can then be sub-divided into typical, critical (safety risk present) and edge-cases [ 6 ] . Edge cases are statistical outliers [ 7 ] that are rarely encountered in normal operational activities and lie on the boundaries of the ODD. We do not consider these three classes to be mutually exclusive as typical scenarios may be critical and edge cases may be critical. Typical scenarios can be rapidly generated using methods such as random generation where ensuring coverage is the key. Critical scenarios can be targeted by random generation in conjunction with approaches such as fuzzy logic [ 8 ] and could fall under typical or edge case.

paragraphs.en: Modern safety standards for autonomous systems such as ISO 21448: safety of the intended functionality (SOTIF) [ 5 ] and PAS 8800 [ 9 ] require specification of spatial edge case scenarios. The wide operating context of autonomous systems means the parameter space of Θ \Theta is vast and the parameters have complex, non-linear relationships. Identifying the parameters θ \theta to describe realistic edge case is complex and challenging. For example, placing an obstacle in a specific location may only cause a hazard if other obstacles are placed in specific locations. ISO 21448 clause 7 requires us to identify triggering conditions such as specific environmental layouts that expose functional gaps and lead to hazardous events. Clause 8 considers residual risk and introduces principles such as ALARP (as low as reasonably practicable) to reduce risk until any further reduction would cost far more than the safety benefit. Clause 9 mandates developing a verification strategy so we can find and mitigate issues and clause 10 mandates verification of the known scenario space to argue that known hazards are handled cleanly. We need to consider clause 11 which mandates validation of the unknown scenario space using testing approaches such as simulation and randomized scenario scaling. As the operational design domain of autonomous systems is vast, testing is limited by the resources available so needs to be focused where it is most useful and the ODD specification, whether specified by text or as a model, may not fully capture every scenario possible. Humans can provide linguistic descriptions and specify parameters ranges and distributions but producing a comprehensive set of concrete edge case scenarios by hand is infeasible due to this vast parameter space. Classical scenario generation for autonomous navigation such as Monte Carlo sampling struggles with high-dimensionality and does not target edge cases. For safety assurance, we are particularly interested in finding critical edge cases so we can mitigate the risks. Finding these safety-critical edge cases and testing them can lead to design, ODD or algorithm refinements and demonstrates that functional gaps have been considered and any found have been mitigated.

paragraphs.en: As the level of automation in autonomous systems increases, ensuring they are safe to operate in safety-critical domains requires safety assurance methodologies specifically targeted at this task. Traditional safety standards such as ISO 26262 [ 11 ] for functional safety were designed around deterministic software architectures and explicit boundary conditions pre-specified in the ODD. For AI-enabled systems, these standards exhibit clear gaps, in particular failing to account for performance gaps rooted in the high-dimensional input spaces of AI-based systems. The operating environment may be underspecified at design time, or even unknown, and the generalisation of design-time verification to run-time safety is problematic which all increase the likelihood of functional gaps [ 12 ] . Thus, autonomous systems lack well-understood safety guarantees and this can lead to unpredictability and ultimately hazardous failures [ 13 ] . Furthermore, current AI validation approaches rely on empirical performance metrics (such as recall and precision) evaluated over static datasets. This hides local performance failures and fails to quantify the AI model’s capacity for safe interpolation and extrapolation when encountering edge cases or out-of-distribution scenarios [ 1 ] in the ODD.
paragraphs.zh: 随着自主系统自动化水平的提升，确保其在安全关键领域能够安全运行，需要采用专门针对这一任务的安全保障方法。 传统的安全标准（如功能安全的 ISO 26262 [ 11 ]）是围绕确定性软件架构以及在 ODD 中预先指定的明确边界条件而设计的。 对于人工智能赋能的系统，这些标准存在明显不足，尤其未能考虑到源于人工智能系统高维输入空间的性能差距。 运行环境在设计阶段可能未被充分定义，甚至完全未知，而将设计阶段的验证结果推广到运行时安全也存在困难，这些因素都会增加功能缺陷出现的可能性 [ 12 ] 。 因此，自主系统缺乏被充分理解的安全保障，这可能导致不可预测性，并最终引发危险故障 [ 13 ] 。 此外，当前的人工智能验证方法依赖于在静态数据集上评估的经验性性能指标（如召回率和精确率）。 这种做法掩盖了局部性能故障，且未能量化人工智能模型在面对 ODD 中的边缘情况或分布外场景时进行安全内插和外推的能力 [ 1 ] 。

paragraphs.en: The newer ISO 21448 (SOTIF) [ 5 ] lifecycle prescribes procedures for identifying and controlling system risks so the residual risk shall be demonstrated to be below an acceptable level by gathering evidence from safety verification and validation. Further, SOTIF defines four areas based on two metrics; knowledge of the scenario and safety . It classifies all scenarios along using these two metrics as axes, knowledge (known/unknown) and hazard (safe/unsafe) where unsafe are the critical scenarios defined earlier. System verification focuses on area 2 (known/unsafe: boundary tests to pinpoint where a system transitions from failing to safe) and validation focuses on area 3 (unknown/unsafe: edge cases that are real-world situations that system engineers have not tested). Thus, identifying boundaries between safe and unsafe and identifying edge case scenarios to reduce their occurrence within the ODD is an urgent problem in safety verification and validation [ 14 ] and is the focus of this research. Edge cases have a Triggering Condition (SOTIF Clause 7) which represents a specific set of parameters (physical properties and environmental states) that cause a functional gap where system performance does not meet desired performance. They can be identified by system-level safety analysis, component-level failure analysis, fault trees, and simulation. Scenario generation tools coupled with simulation are designed specifically to combine parameters until a (functional gap) triggering condition occurs. [ 15 ] note the importance of scenario-based testing during the development lifecycle for assuring the safety of autonomous systems.
paragraphs.zh: 较新的 ISO 21448（SOTIF）[ 5 ] 生命周期规定了识别和控制系统风险的程序，以便通过收集安全验证和确认的证据，证明剩余风险低于可接受水平。 此外，SOTIF 基于两个指标定义了四个领域：对场景的了解以及安全性。 它利用这两个指标作为坐标轴，将所有场景进行分类：知识（已知/未知）和危险（安全/不安全），其中不安全的情况即前文定义的关键场景。 系统验证重点关注领域 2（已知/不安全：通过边界测试确定系统从失效转为安全的临界点），而系统确认则重点关注领域 3（未知/不安全：系统工程师尚未测试过的真实世界中的边缘情况）。 因此，识别安全与不安全状态之间的边界，并识别边缘情况场景以减少其在 ODD 内的出现，是安全验证和确认中一个亟待解决的问题 [ 14 ]，也是本研究的核心。 边缘情况具有一个触发条件（SOTIF 第 7 条），该条件代表一组特定的参数（物理属性和环境状态），会导致功能缺口，即系统性能无法满足预期性能。 这些边缘情况可以通过系统级安全分析、组件级故障分析、故障树和模拟来识别。 与模拟结合使用的场景生成工具专门设计用于组合各种参数，直到触发（功能缺口）条件出现。 [ 15 ] 指出在开发生命周期中开展基于场景的测试对于确保自主系统的安全性至关重要。

sents.en: The newer ISO 21448 (SOTIF) [ 5 ] lifecycle prescribes procedures for identifying and controlling system risks so the residual risk shall be demonstrated to be below an acceptable level by gathering evidence from safety verification and validation.
sents.zh: 较新的 ISO 21448（SOTIF）[ 5 ] 生命周期规定了识别和控制系统风险的程序，以便通过收集安全验证和确认的证据，证明剩余风险低于可接受水平。

sents.en: Further, SOTIF defines four areas based on two metrics; knowledge of the scenario and safety .
sents.zh: 此外，SOTIF 基于两个指标定义了四个领域：对场景的了解以及安全性。

sents.en: It classifies all scenarios along using these two metrics as axes, knowledge (known/unknown) and hazard (safe/unsafe) where unsafe are the critical scenarios defined earlier.
sents.zh: 它利用这两个指标作为坐标轴，将所有场景进行分类：知识（已知/未知）和危险（安全/不安全），其中不安全的情况即前文定义的关键场景。

sents.en: System verification focuses on area 2 (known/unsafe: boundary tests to pinpoint where a system transitions from failing to safe) and validation focuses on area 3 (unknown/unsafe: edge cases that are real-world situations that system engineers have not tested).
sents.zh: 系统验证重点关注领域 2（已知/不安全：通过边界测试确定系统从失效转为安全的临界点），而系统确认则重点关注领域 3（未知/不安全：系统工程师尚未测试过的真实世界中的边缘情况）。

sents.en: Thus, identifying boundaries between safe and unsafe and identifying edge case scenarios to reduce their occurrence within the ODD is an urgent problem in safety verification and validation [ 14 ] and is the focus of this research.
sents.zh: 因此，识别安全与不安全状态之间的边界，并识别边缘情况场景以减少其在 ODD 内的出现，是安全验证和确认中一个亟待解决的问题 [ 14 ]，也是本研究的核心。

sents.en: Edge cases have a Triggering Condition (SOTIF Clause 7) which represents a specific set of parameters (physical properties and environmental states) that cause a functional gap where system performance does not meet desired performance.
sents.zh: 边缘情况具有一个触发条件（SOTIF 第 7 条），该条件代表一组特定的参数（物理属性和环境状态），会导致功能缺口，即系统性能无法满足预期性能。

sents.en: They can be identified by system-level safety analysis, component-level failure analysis, fault trees, and simulation.
sents.zh: 这些边缘情况可以通过系统级安全分析、组件级故障分析、故障树和模拟来识别。

paragraphs.en: PAS 8800 (Road Vehicles - Safety and Artificial Intelligence) [ 9 ] complements ISO 21448 with a normative safety framework for managing the AI safety lifecycle. While PAS 8800 defines the necessary safety objectives and process requirements, it remains strictly non-prescriptive regarding implementation mechanisms. PAS 8800 specifies what must be achieved to ensure safety but leaves an open methodological gap regarding how these requirements can be verified, quantified, and traceably validated in practice. While SOTIF testing identifies triggering conditions, PAS 8800 mandates that synthetic edge-case scenarios must be generated to identify data gaps, AI model gaps, non-deterministic behaviour and to validate the AI model’s generalisation and robustness boundaries [ 9 ] .
paragraphs.zh: PAS 8800（道路车辆——安全与人工智能）[ 9 ] 通过为管理人工智能安全生命周期提供规范性安全框架，对 ISO 21448 进行了补充。 尽管 PAS 8800 定义了必要的安全目标和流程要求，但在实施机制方面仍严格保持非规定性。 PAS 8800 明确了确保安全必须实现的目标，但在如何实际验证、量化并可追溯地确认这些要求方面，仍存在方法论上的空白。 虽然 SOTIF 测试能够识别触发条件，但 PAS 8800 要求必须生成合成的极端场景，以识别数据缺口、人工智能模型缺口和非确定性行为，并验证人工智能模型的泛化能力和鲁棒性边界 [ 9 ]。

paragraphs.en: STAMP (System-Theoretic Accident Model and Processes) is a safety framework based on systems theory and STPA (System-Theoretic Process Analysis) is a hazard analysis method derived from STAMP [ 16 ] . Together they can generate scenarios [ 17 ] . However, the number of scenarios generated can be large which is ideal for ensuring scenario coverage but not for targetting edge cases as only a small portion of the scenarios generated will be edge cases (the long tail of the distribution). [ 17 ] use statistical model-checking to search the STAMP/STPA scenario space for critical scenarios (those likely to cause hazards). However, the approach requires specification of UML and statistical modelling templates which are bespoke to the application and not generalisable. Our approach would complement STAMP/STPA by supplementing it with targeted edge cases.
paragraphs.zh: STAMP（系统理论事故模型与流程）是一个基于系统理论的安全框架，而 STPA（系统理论流程分析）则是从 STAMP 衍生出的一种风险分析方法 [ 16 ]。 二者结合可以生成各种场景 [ 17 ]。 然而，生成的场景数量可能非常庞大，这虽然有利于确保场景覆盖，却不利于针对边缘案例，因为生成的场景中只有很小一部分是边缘案例（即分布的长尾部分）。 [ 17] 使用统计模型检查法在 STAMP/STPA 的场景空间中搜索关键场景（即可能导致风险的场景）。 然而，这种方法需要定义 UML 和统计建模模板，而这些模板是专为特定应用设计的，无法通用。 我们的方法可以通过补充针对性的边缘案例来完善 STAMP/STPA。

paragraphs.en: SACE (Safety Assurance of Autonomous Systems in Complex Environments) [ 18 ] is an eight-stage methodology to safety assure autonomous systems considering their operational domain. Within SACE, scenario generation is important for identifying hazardous interactions with the operational environment in stage 2 to discover risks, for boundary testing using edge-case scenarios in stage 7 and for verifying system behaviour in stage 8 using simulation and testing pipelines to generate the necessary evidence for a justified safety case. SACE encourages the use of simulation-based testing using a scenario coverage approach but provides little guidance as to how to do it.
paragraphs.zh: SACE（复杂环境中的自主系统安全保证）[ 18 ] 是一种包含八个阶段的方法论，用于在考虑自主系统运行域的同时对其安全性进行保障。 在 SACE 中，场景生成至关重要：它在第 2 阶段用于识别与运行环境之间的危险交互以发现风险；在第 7 阶段通过极限场景进行边界测试；并在第 8 阶段利用模拟和测试流程验证系统行为，从而生成合理安全论证所需的必要证据。 SACE 鼓励采用基于场景覆盖的模拟测试方法，但并未提供太多关于如何具体实施的建议。

paragraphs.en: Simulation-based testing is vital to overcome the testing bottleneck as comprehensively testing autonomous systems across their operational domain is highly complex and computationally expensive. Simulation provides a secure and fully-controlled environment to test the scenarios generated including testing edge cases without risking human life, the environment or property. [ 19 , 20 ] survey and critique simulation of autonomous robots focusing on the technologies used and how simulation can ensure the safety, reliability and robustness of the robots.
paragraphs.zh: 基于模拟的测试对于突破测试瓶颈至关重要，因为对自主系统在其整个运行域内进行全面测试极其复杂且计算成本高昂。 模拟提供了一个安全且完全受控的环境，用于测试生成的各种场景，包括极端情况，而无需冒危及人类生命、环境或财产的风险。 [ 19 , 20 ] 对自主机器人的模拟进行了综述与批判性分析，重点探讨了所采用的技术以及模拟如何确保机器人的安全性、可靠性和鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: We can test in simulation and then transition to real-world testing. This requires the simulation to accurately represent the real-world to ensure the simulation testing is valid. Simulations operate at different levels of fidelity. However, [ 21 ] show that even low fidelity simulation can unearth bugs in a robot’s navigation system. Popular robotic simulation environments such as Gazebo have been used for scenario analyses [ 22 ] . For higher fidelity, game engines such as Unity-3D can realistically simulate complex and dynamic environments, making them ideal for robotics and vehicle simulation. For example, [ 6 ] use the CARLA simulator which is based on the Unreal game engine and is aimed at road vehicle simulation and [ 23 ] show that Unity-3D game engine scales better, achieves better visuals and is more capable of real-time LiDAR simulation than a traditional robotic simulation environment such as Gazebo.

paragraphs.en: Scenario generation overcomes the data scarcity bottleneck for training AI components of autonomous systems by generating large numbers of scenarios from some more general specification of the scenario space (e.g. a description of the ODD). It can be targeted specifically at edge case scenarios to challenge the system’s safety boundaries and learn optimal behaviour through systematic testing. There is a range of techniques for scenario generation covering typical, critical and edge case scenarios.

paragraphs.en: [ 24 ] use Monte Carlo simulations to generate test cases from a parameterised representation. However, the Monte Carlo simulation is a random search and not targetting edge cases. [ 8 ] adopt a fuzzy-logic approach which combines human-like descriptions with degrees of membership to target critical scenarios. By using ISO 34504:2024’s tag-based scenario categorisation [ 25 ] the authors transform an abstract ODD into a concrete, parametrised model describing the possible operating conditions. This motivates an approach that can systematically organize environmental factors, the system description and requirements from the ODD and the task description to represent the combinatorial space of possible autonomous system scenarios.
paragraphs.zh: [ 24 ] 使用蒙特卡洛模拟从参数化表示中生成测试用例。 然而，蒙特卡洛模拟是一种随机搜索方法，并不会针对边缘情况。 [ 8 ] 采用模糊逻辑方法，将类人描述与隶属度相结合，以针对关键场景。 通过采用 ISO 34504:2024 的基于标签的场景分类法 [ 25 ]，作者将一个抽象的 ODD 转化为一个具体的参数化模型，用于描述可能的运行条件。 这启发了一种方法，能够系统性地组织环境因素、系统描述以及来自 ODD 和任务描述的需求，以表示自主系统可能场景的组合空间。

paragraphs.en: There is a lack of automated, compute-efficient tools that map from high-level safety standards onto executable 3D scenarios specified using standardised formats. There has been a body of work generating scenarios for safety assurance using LLMs but many focus on generating visual scenes [ 31 , 32 ] and adversarial behaviour simulation [ 33 , 34 ] . [ 35 ] introduce a pipeline to generate safety-critical scenarios from crash reports and road network diagrams but this requires such datasets to be available. [ 36 ] introduce SERA an LLM pipeline to create targeted scenarios from failure cases by analysing performance logs to pinpoint failure patterns and then retrieving semantically aligned scenarios from a pre-existing database of scenarios. [ 37 ] developed a semi-automated pipeline that transforms operational design domain (ODD) descriptions (text) into executable CARLA simulation scenarios. They decompose the ODD description using structured prompt engineering and reasoning into structured scenario specifications which can be run on simulation platforms, such as CARLA. Their second stage uses a second LLM to refine the scenario using known simulation error patterns and corresponding corrections. They also note that this may require minor manual interventions and adjustments or compensation for missing assets in the simulation. PlannerForge [ 38 ] is also a semi-automated pipeline where the user describes their required scenario in an LLM prompt, the LLM converts this to JSON to systematically describe the user’s intent and creates a scenario using maps and simulated layouts which the user edits. Targeting critical scenarios would require the user to specify critical scenarios in advance.
paragraphs.zh: 目前缺乏能够自动且高效利用计算资源、将高级安全标准映射到使用标准化格式指定的可执行三维场景的工具。 已有大量研究利用大语言模型生成用于安全验证的场景，但许多研究主要集中在生成视觉场景 [31, 32] 和对抗性行为模拟 [33, 34] 上。 [35] 提出了一种从碰撞报告和道路网络图中生成安全关键性场景的流程，但这需要相关数据集可用。 [36] 提出了 SERA——一种大语言模型流程，通过分析性能日志定位故障模式，从而从故障案例中创建目标场景，并从预存的场景数据库中检索语义匹配的场景。 [37] 开发了一种半自动化流程，可将运行设计域（ODD）描述（文本）转换为可执行的 CARLA 模拟场景。 他们通过结构化提示工程和推理，将 ODD 描述分解为可在 CARLA 等模拟平台上运行的结构化场景规范。 第二阶段使用第二个大语言模型，结合已知的模拟错误模式及对应的修正方法，对场景进行优化。 他们还指出，这一过程可能需要少量的人工干预和调整，或对模拟中缺失的资产进行补偿。 PlannerForge [38] 也是一种半自动化流程：用户在大语言模型提示中描述所需场景，大语言模型将其转换为 JSON 以系统化地描述用户意图，并利用地图和模拟布局创建场景，再由用户进行编辑。 若要针对关键场景，用户需提前明确指定这些关键场景。

paragraphs.en: Our approach is fully automated and does not require prior knowledge of errors, functional gaps or critical scenario examples. Its purpose is to uncover such errors and gaps. In the following sections, we develop an agentic framework that focuses on edge cases, directly links the ODD to the scenario-generation, does not require prior knowledge of functional gaps or for the entire system and environment to be fully modelled, does not require extensive trial and error testing to fine-tune the scenario generation process, is fully automated and incorporates feedback and dynamic adjustment into the scenario generation process. It is directed by safety assurance processes as we decompose the ODD to a domain ontology with three sections: { environment description, system description, system requirements } and we also supply a { task description } for scenario generation. We represent these as knowledge bases (see Section 4.2 ) which provide information and context in the prompt.

paragraphs.en: The agentic loop’s task is to search the scenario parameter space for SOTIF triggering conditions derived from formal safety specifications. Triggering conditions are specific events or spatial layouts that uncover a system weakness that leads to a hazard such as not maintaining safe separation from an obstacle. To find triggers, the lifecycle comprises a number of steps that loop. We illustrate the lifecycle in Figures 2 and 3 . In Figure 2 , step 1) integrates the four sections of our ODD as inputs to an LM, LLM1, which generates 2) draft scenarios and 3) validates them for syntax correctness. A second (different) reflection LM, LLM2, critiques each scenario (4) and LLM1 uses the 5) critique to 6) revise and refine each scenario (7) which is 8) syntactically validated and 9) stored in a scenario history database. In Figure 3 , step 10 runs each scenario in turn through a simulator and 11) outputs a set of quality metrics (evals), step 12 analyses the metrics and decides whether to 13) exploit or explore, step 14 loops back to the original LM and either exploits (prompts to create more similar scenarios using the current scenario) or explores using the history database in the prompt to generate scenarios that are different from those in the history. Once we have finished looping, we have a set of JSON-encoded scenarios and associated evaluation metric results through simulation that form our traceable safety assurance evidence towards showing that g ⁡ ( 𝐀𝐒 ) g(\mathbf{AS}) are met (as described in section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体循环的任务是在场景参数空间中搜索源自正式安全规范的 SOTIF 触发条件。 触发条件是指特定的事件或空间布局，它们会暴露系统的弱点，进而导致危险，例如未能与障碍物保持安全距离。 为了找到这些触发条件，生命周期包含一系列循环执行的步骤。 我们在图 2 和图 3 中展示了这一生命周期。 在图 2 中，步骤 1) 将我们 ODD 的四个部分整合为输入提供给语言模型 LLM1，该模型会生成 2) 初步场景并 3) 验证其语法正确性。 第二个（不同的）反思型语言模型 LLM2 会对每个场景进行 4) 批判性评估，而 LLM1 则会利用 5) 这些评估结果来 6) 修订和完善每个场景（7），随后该场景会经过 8) 语法验证并 9) 存储到场景历史数据库中。 在图 3 中，步骤 10) 依次将每个场景输入模拟器运行，并 11) 输出一组质量指标（评估结果）；步骤 12) 分析这些指标，并决定是 13) 利用现有场景还是探索新场景；步骤 14) 循环回到最初的语言模型，通过利用当前场景提示生成更多相似场景（利用策略），或借助历史数据库中的内容提示生成与历史不同的场景（探索策略）。 完成循环后，我们将获得一组以 JSON 编码的场景以及通过模拟得到的相关评估指标结果，这些共同构成了我们可追溯的安全保障证据，用以证明 g⁡(𝐀𝐒) g(\mathbf{AS}) 已满足（如第 4.3 节所述）。

paragraphs.en: We describe how to post-process the generated JSON encoding the scenario and simulation evaluation metrics in sections 6.2 and 7.2 . This uses analyses inspired by thematic analyses [ 39 ] to identify SOTIF triggering conditions, cross-reference the evaluation metric scores for those SOTIF triggers and uses the results as safety assurance evidence. paragraphs.en: Our agentic AI framework is a closed loop that feeds back the evaluation outcomes generated by running the scenarios through the simulator and uses them to improve the next set of generated scenarios thus moving beyond random sampling. It incorporates a “ domain ontology ” which represents the ODD and is specified as a machine-readable model comprising { environment description, system description, system requirements, } coupled with a task description (see Figure 2 and section 4.2 ). The think, act, observe update and continue loops as described in Section 3.2 exploit chain-of-thought prompting [ 40 ] by decomposing prompts into step-by-step chunks which reduces logic and reasoning errors in the LMs. We couple this with representing the domain ontology as knowledge bases (see section 4.2 ) to include structured knowledge into the LM’s prompt creating a contextual prompt [ 41 ] with background information, specifications, rules, requirements and goals. The prompts are also schema-strict and force the LM to convert qualitative descriptions (e.g., “focus on edge cases with dense obstacle clusters”) into quantitative coordinates and environmental layouts in a strict predefined data layout. For our current use case, the loop outputs JSON specifying spatial object placements such as obstacle layouts targeted at SOTIF triggering conditions. Our framework is adversarial as our task description prompts the LMs (see Listing 11 ) to generate long tail scenarios such as complex obstacle patterns or obstacle walls that specifically target likely functional gaps. The generator LM generates the scenario which the critic LM validates and critiques so the generator LM can refine the scenario, the autonomous system attempts this refined scenario in simulation, the simulation provides evaluation metrics to feedback and the generator LM can use these to refine existing scenarios (exploit) or generate novel scenarios (explore).

paragraphs.en: Using a structured text representation for scenarios, such as JSON, minimises the communication overhead between LMs and between LMs and simulation compared to using images or models. For a local agentic framework, this is vital to minimise the demands on the compute resources available and allows closed-loop execution to run alongside Unity-3D simulation on a single GPU laptop. Generating multiple scenarios from one prompt (Step 1 in Figure 2 ) ensures a variety of scenarios will be produced. However, testing indicated that attempting to generate too many from one prompt leads to the Qwen LM used here generating errors in the JSON as working memory is smaller in local models and they drift and forget to match brackets, for example. We generate JSON-encoded scenarios in batches of four, i.e., request four scenarios from the LM as this is the highest value that leads to error-free scenarios. We also use the Python package Pydantic and our Python software to validate all generated JSON and all data types (such as ensuring coordinates are integers) and to fix simple JSON syntax issues such as missing closing braces before the JSON-encoded scenario is executed in simulation. Running the simulation is the most compute-intensive step of the closed loop so ensuring the JSON-encoded scenario is correct and optimised before simulation is important in a local agentic setup. It is also important that all scenario are valid so if the LM hallucinates a new JSON field then Pydantic will catch the error and can provide feedback for further scenario revision.

paragraphs.en: Generally, the smaller LMs have smaller context windows as they have less working memory and can process fewer tokens (words) in their prompts. These smaller LMs can fall into “local minima” where they are stuck on a small set of specific archetypes and themes causing output repetition. We have deliberately created a multi-step agentic architecture using think, act, observe, update, and continue loops so we do not rely on a single prompt for scenario creation. Additionally, the smaller prompt length forces us to use a “sliding window history” implemented as a short FIFO queue of text describing scenarios (taken from the JSON generated by the LMs) as there is not enough room for the full JSON specifications or even all historical scenarios so we focus on a brief text description of recent scenarios. As new scenarios are generated then the oldest is popped and removed from the queue. Keeping a small FIFO queue in memory is feasible and removes the overhead of running and accessing a database of past scenarios on our laptop.
paragraphs.zh: 通常，较小的语言模型（LM）具有更小的上下文窗口，因为它们的工作记忆较少，无法在提示中处理更多的词元（词语）。 这些较小的语言模型可能会陷入“局部最小值”，即它们会固着于少数特定的原型和主题，导致输出重复。 我们特意构建了一种多步骤的智能体架构，采用“思考、行动、观察、更新和继续”的循环机制，因此无需依赖单个提示来生成场景。 此外，较短的提示长度迫使我们使用“滑动窗口历史”机制，具体实现为一个简短的先进先出（FIFO）文本队列，用于描述场景（内容取自语言模型生成的 JSON），因为提示中无法容纳完整的 JSON 规范甚至所有历史场景，因此我们仅保留近期场景的简要文本描述。 每当生成新场景时，队列中最旧的条目会被弹出并移除。 在内存中维护一个小型的先进先出队列是可行的，并且可以避免在笔记本电脑上运行和访问历史场景数据库所带来的额外负担。

paragraphs.en: The level of creativity of a LM is controlled by its temperature parameter. Using simple analyses of inspecting sets of 8 scenarios generated using different temperature values, we found that a value of temperature = 0.7 provided the best trade-off between creativity and sticking to the rules. We note that increasing the temperature and hence creativity too far can lead to the introduction of LM hallucinations.
paragraphs.zh: 语言模型（LM）的创造力水平由其温度参数控制。 通过对使用不同温度值生成的 8 个场景集合进行简单分析，我们发现当温度值设为 0.7 时，在创造力和遵守规则之间实现了最佳平衡。 我们注意到，过度提高温度从而过度提升创造力，可能会导致语言模型（LM）产生幻觉。

paragraphs.en: Furthermore, using a different LM for generation, Qwen, with Nemotron for reflection aims to reduce the “confirmation bias” we observed when we used a single LM, Qwen, to self-critique. Minimising confirmation bias is vital for safety assurance as it reduces system robustness. This difference also provides a strict separation of LM persona, allows us to use strict rubric and engineering requirements for the different contextual prompts to the different LMs and allows us to choose models specifically for their skills such as coding models for JSON generation or reasoning models for reflection.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，使用不同的语言模型（LM）进行生成（Qwen），并结合 Nemotron 进行反思，旨在减少我们在仅使用单一语言模型（Qwen）进行自我批判时所观察到的“确认偏误”。 最小化确认偏误对安全性保障至关重要，因为它会降低系统的稳健性。 这种差异也实现了语言模型角色（LM persona）的严格分离，使我们能够针对不同语言模型的不同上下文提示采用严格的评分标准和工程要求，并允许我们根据特定技能选择模型，例如使用编码模型进行 JSON 生成，或使用推理模型进行反思。

paragraphs.en: ML-agents uses Unity-3D’s C# development framework as a front-end and middleware, and to interface to a Python API backend for AI training and simulation [ 48 ] . In this paper, we adapt the ML-agents Sorter simulation and revise and augment the approach we used in [ 49 ] by changing the task to be multistage (visiting multiple tiles in order while avoiding obstacles), improving the simulation environment so the robotic-agent can turn through 0-359 o (rather than being limited to moving in the 4 cardinal directions), accelerate and decelerate, we added a LiDAR to the agent and use these sensor data during RL navigation, we enabled scenario specification in JSON format and added evaluation metric output in JSON format.

paragraphs.en: The agent navigates using LiDAR (a 7 beam ray perception sensor) which realistically represents navigation in the real-world where the robotic-agent can only sense its local environment and may not see obstacles ahead due to occlusions. The agent receives a small penalty for each movement (-2/5000), an additional penalty (-1/5000) for reversing (to stop it travelling backwards as much as possible as it has no rear-facing LiDAR). These values were established using simple trial and error analyses of value ranges to determine the value that caused the robotic-agent to behave as desired: i.e., travel towards tiles avoiding obstacles and minimising osculation and back-tracking. The agent receives a positive reward (+1) for visiting the correct next tile, and a negative reward (-1) for either visiting the wrong tile or colliding with an obstacle. Each episode terminates if the robotic-agent reaches the highest value tile (SUCCESS), after 5000 steps (TIMES OUT), or if the robotic-agent visits the wrong tile (WRONG TILE).
paragraphs.zh: 智能体通过激光雷达（一种 7 束光线的感知传感器）进行导航，这真实地再现了现实世界中的导航场景：机器人智能体只能感知其局部环境，并且可能因遮挡而无法看到前方的障碍物。 每次移动时，智能体会受到轻微的惩罚（-2/5000）；若出现倒退行为，则会受到额外的惩罚（-1/5000），以防止其尽可能多地向后移动（因为它没有朝向后方的激光雷达）。 这些数值是通过简单的试错分析不同数值范围而确定的，目的是找到能让机器人智能体表现出预期行为的值：即向高价值格点移动、避开障碍物，并尽量减少遮挡和回溯。 当智能体到达正确的下一个格点时，会获得正向奖励（+1）；若到达错误的格点或与障碍物碰撞，则会获得负向奖励（-1）。 如果机器人智能体到达最高价值格点（成功），经过 5000 步（超时），或者访问了错误的格点（错误格点），则当前回合结束。

paragraphs.en: We need to take a hierarchical view when safety assuring autonomous systems by first considering system-level (product-based) safety assurance. We then work through levels of abstraction to assure the components of the autonomous system, such as the navigation process, while considering the system level requirements and goals. ML failures lead to software failures which, in turn, leads to a system level failure and a hazard [ 50 ] . Therefore, we need to argue that the navigation component meets its particular safety requirements and provide verification and validation of the associated system-level requirements. Using this hierarchical approach the claim of meeting each safety claim (goal) will be supported by other testing and argumentation. To capture the form of this argument, we use goal structuring notation (GSN) [ 51 ] which is widely used in academia and industry to systematically capture safety assurance argumentation. Our top claim is G1 “ avoid collisions with infrastructure - is demonstrably satisfied at system level ” to meet safety requirement 1: “ The RL-based navigation operates the robotic-agent within a defined safety limit: it ensures zero collisions with infrastructure during navigation cycles ”. Figure 5 shows G1 for the autonomous system’s navigation decomposed to lower level goals G1.1, G1.2, G1.3 for the verification to demonstrate that the autonomous system’s navigation component meets the claim in G1. This approach follows the methodology of SACE, specifically SACE stage 8 [ 18 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 在确保自主系统安全时，我们需要采取分层视角，首先考虑系统级（基于产品）的安全保障。 接着，我们通过不同抽象层次来保障自主系统的各个组件（例如导航过程），同时兼顾系统级的需求与目标。 机器学习故障会导致软件故障，而软件故障又会引发系统级故障和潜在风险 [ 50 ] 。 因此，我们需要论证导航组件满足其特定的安全要求，并对相关的系统级需求进行验证与确认。 采用这种分层方法，对每个安全主张（目标）的达成声明，都将由其他测试和论证提供支持。 为了捕捉这种论证形式，我们使用目标结构化记法（GSN）[ 51 ]，该方法在学术界和工业界被广泛用于系统性地记录安全保障的论证过程。 我们的顶层主张是 G1：“避免与基础设施发生碰撞——这一点在系统层已得到明确验证”，以满足安全要求 1：“基于强化学习的导航使机器人智能体在定义的安全限制内运行：确保在导航周期中不与基础设施发生任何碰撞”。 图 5 展示了自主系统导航的 G1 主张如何分解为更底层的子目标 G1.1、G1.2 和 G1.3，通过验证证明自主系统的导航组件满足 G1 中的主张。 这种方法遵循 SACE 的方法论，具体而言是 SACE 的第 8 阶段 [ 18 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Our domain ontology represents the ODD and comprises the environment description, system description and system requirements. Each section of the domain ontology along with the task description is a specific “knowledge base” (KB) providing guidance for the LM with respect to the spatial layout, physical laws that must be obeyed, the data schema, and logical goals of Unity-3D ML-Agents environment and what to generate. The knowledge bases combine in our contextual (knowledge-based) prompts passed to the LM, similar to [ 41 ] . The KBs are encoded as YAML markup which can define entities and their relationships similar to a database but in a human readable format. This YAML specification allows us to specify requirements as non-negotiable constraints on the system and environment. It provides contextual alignment and reduces hallucination by focusing on the specifics of the task and helps to ensure valid JSON outputs. The environment description is given in Listing 8 , system description in Listing 9 & system requirements in Listing 10 ) along with the task description in Listing 11 . The KBs are included in the prompts for 1) initial JSON-encoded scenarios, 4) critique, 6) revise using critique, 13/14) exploit using successful JSON-encoded scenario and 13/14) explore by creating novel JSON-encoded scenarios using history. Combining The KBs in contextual prompts aims to ensure that the agentic framework generates JSON-encoded scenarios that are valid w.r.t. the ODD and JSON schema.

paragraphs.en: ISO 21448: Clause 7 mandates the identification and analysis of functional gaps and their triggering conditions. paragraphs.en: Formally, RL is a Markov decision process (MDP), comprising:

paragraphs.en: A finite set of states S S , plus a distribution of starting states p ⁡ ( s 0 ) p(s_{0}) . There may be a terminal state, s T s_{T} .

paragraphs.en: A set of actions A A available in each state.

paragraphs.en: A policy π θ ​ ( s t + 1 | s t , a t ) \pi_{\theta}(s_{t+1}|s_{t},a_{t}) that maps state/action pairs at time t t onto a distribution of states at time t + 1 t+1 using parameter set θ \theta .
paragraphs.zh: 策略 π θ ​ ( s t + 1 | s t , a t ) \pi_{\theta}(s_{t+1}|s_{t},a_{t}) 将时间 t t 的状态/动作对映射到时间 t + 1 t+1 的状态分布上，其中使用参数集 θ \theta 。

paragraphs.en: An instantaneous reward function R ⁡ ( s t , a t , s t + 1 ) R(s_{t},a_{t},s_{t+1}) associated with each transition to s t + 1 s_{t+1} .
paragraphs.zh: 与每个转移到 s t + 1 s_{t+1} 的过渡相关联的瞬时奖励函数 R ⁡ ( s t , a t , s t + 1 ) R(s_{t},a_{t},s_{t+1})。

paragraphs.en: A discount factor γ ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] \gamma\in[0,1] , which is the current value of future rewards. It quantifies the difference in importance between immediate rewards and future rewards (lower values place more emphasis on immediate rewards).

paragraphs.en: We treat our operational domain as a partially observable MDP or POMDP as the LiDAR only detects obstacles that intercept its beams so obstacles ahead may be obscured and unknown. Here the observation is described by a mapping in a state-space-model that depends on the current state.

paragraphs.en: RL learns a parameterised policy function π \pi which gives the probability of taking action a t a_{t} given the current state s t s_{t} according to the deep RL model with weights parameters θ \theta . Thus, π θ ​ ( a t | s t ) = P ⁡ [ A t = a t | S t = s t ] \pi_{\theta}(a_{t}|s_{t})=P[A_{t}=a_{t}|S_{t}=s_{t}] . A policy fully defines the behaviour of the robotic-agent given the current state, and that action, when executed, generates a reward r t r_{t} . The aim of RL is to identify the optimal policy, π ∗ \pi^{*} , which maximises the reward over all states (i.e. maximises the expected reward value E E ): π ∗ = a ​ r ​ g ​ m ​ a ​ x π ​ E ​ [ R t | π ] \pi^{*}=argmax_{\pi}\,E[R_{t}|\pi] . As in our previous paper, [ 49 ] , we use proximal policy optimisation (PPO) [ 52 ] which computes an update at each time step t t that minimizes the cost function while ensuring the deviation from the previous policy is relatively small. PPO prevents large, destructive policy changes, making it highly efficient for training autonomous systems. In [ 49 ] , we developed incremental curriculum learning for training our robotic-agent’s using PPO which we describe next.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习（RL）会学习一个参数化的策略函数 π，该函数根据当前状态 s_t 给出采取动作 a_t 的概率，其依据是具有权重参数 θ 的深度强化学习模型。 因此，π_θ(a_t|s_t) = P[A_t=a_t|S_t=s_t]。 在给定当前状态时，策略完全定义了机器人智能体的行为；而执行该动作会产生一个奖励 r_t。 强化学习的目标是确定最优策略 π*，它能使所有状态下的奖励最大化（即最大化期望奖励值 E）：π* = argmax_π E[R_t|π]。 与我们的先前论文 [49] 一样，我们使用了近端策略优化（PPO）[52]，该方法在每个时间步 t 计算一次更新，以最小化成本函数，同时确保与先前策略的偏差相对较小。 PPO 可防止策略发生大规模且破坏性的变化，因此对于训练自主系统而言效率极高。 在 [49] 中，我们为使用 PPO 训练机器人智能体开发了一种增量式课程学习方法，下文将对此进行描述。

paragraphs.en: Curriculum learning is used for autonomous system development as it allows the RL to begin learning in simulation and then transition and continue learning in the real-world. Curriculum learning begins with a simple task and gradually increases the task complexity until it reaches the required operational domain. We began with up to 2 tiles with values 1 & 2 placed randomly, 5 fixed obstacles in different positions per arena to provide continuity during training and evaluation and 5 randomly placed obstacles all with size 1.0. We increment the number of tiles by 2 per lesson (up to 20). Curriculum learning uses transfer learning to transfer the current policy π θ ​ ( a t | s t ) \pi_{\theta}(a_{t}|s_{t}) from each lesson to the next. Our incremental curriculum learning approach [ 49 ] trains the RL brain during a lesson until a metric baseline is exceeded; i.e., until we are satisfied that the PPO has learned that lesson sufficiently. In contrast, traditional curriculum learning pre-specifies the number of epochs for each lesson in advance which may not be sufficient or may cause over-training. We analysed a number of metrics as noted in our previous paper [ 49 ] and found that mean final reward generated the best model (compared to using loss, entropy or steps taken).

paragraphs.en: To test the effectiveness of the trained RL brain w.r.t. coverage, robustness and accuracy, and to uncover functional gaps in its navigation, we analyse the agentic framework against two baseline scenario generation approaches described next. Each approach generates 512 scenarios in total in batches of 8 that follow the JSON schema in Listing 5 . Each batch run in parallel in Unity-3D as shown in Figure 7 for 50 episodes per scenario, giving 512 x 50 =25,600 episodes per approach. PPO models are non-deterministic as PPO uses a stochastic policy designed to explore its environment by sampling actions from a probability distribution. Hence, we run 50 episodes per scenario to factor in this stochastic action selection, and potential randomness within the environment itself.
paragraphs.zh: 为了测试训练好的强化学习智能体在覆盖范围、鲁棒性和准确性方面的有效性，并揭示其导航功能中的缺失环节，我们将该智能体框架与下文描述的两种基准场景生成方法进行比较分析。 每种方法总共生成 512 个场景，按每次 8 个的场景批次生成，并遵循清单 5 中的 JSON 模式。 每个批次都在 Unity-3D 中并行运行（如第 7 图所示），每个场景运行 50 轮，因此每种方法共产生 512 × 50 = 25,600 轮。 PPO 模型是非确定性的，因为 PPO 使用随机策略，通过从概率分布中采样动作来探索其环境。 因此，我们为每个场景运行 50 轮，以考虑这种随机动作选择以及环境本身可能存在的随机性。

paragraphs.en: We developed a large set of scenario evaluation metrics which are output by the Unity-3D simulation as JSON. These aim to evaluate the important factors for scenario generation including those listed in [ 53 ] . Our metrics are listed in Table 2 and assess breadth of coverage, the complexity (time to solve), the diversity, the level of difficulty (hazards), and the frequency of hazards. We also include charts showing the spatial heatmap of obstacle placements, how many times each number (count) of obstacles was selected, how many times each number (count) of tiles was selected, how many times each tile position was selected and how many times each tile value was selected. Success rate, timeout score and wrong tile score coupled with average reward, percentage of tiles visited and collision count measure the difficulty of scenarios as they measure functional gaps. The spatial heatmap of obstacle locations coupled with the obstacle counts, tile counts, tile positions and tile locations demonstrate coverage. Ideal path length measures the complexity and its spread measures the diversity. Average path length, action transition entropy and action distribution entropy measure the complexity, diversity and hazard exposure.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一套大规模的场景评估指标，这些指标由 Unity-3D 模拟以 JSON 格式输出。 这些指标旨在评估场景生成中的关键因素，包括 [53] 中列出的因素。 我们的指标列于表 2 中，用于评估覆盖范围、复杂性（解决时间）、多样性、难度水平（危险）以及危险出现的频率。 我们还加入了图表，展示障碍物的空间热图分布、每种障碍物数量被选择的次数、每种瓦片数量被选择的次数、每种瓦片位置被选择的次数，以及每种瓦片值被选择的次数。 成功率、超时分数和错误瓦片分数，结合平均奖励、已访问瓦片的百分比和碰撞次数，共同衡量了场景的难度，因为它们反映了功能上的缺失。 障碍物位置的空间热图，结合障碍物数量、瓦片数量、瓦片位置和瓦片分布，展示了覆盖范围。 理想路径长度衡量了复杂性，而该长度的分布则衡量了多样性。 平均路径长度、动作转换熵和动作分布熵分别衡量了复杂性、多样性和危险暴露程度。

paragraphs.en: The charts in Figures 17 show that Agentic generation is targeting a subset of scenarios and does not have the coverage or completeness of Random generation. paragraphs.en: The text descriptions of the scenarios produced by the Agentic framework allow a thematic-style analysis which reveals the SOTIF trigger conditions and functional gaps (descriptions of failure modes) and groups scenarios by their descriptive similarities. For example, θ J ​ S ​ O ​ N 1 \theta_{JSON_{1}} & θ J ​ S ​ O ​ N 2 \theta_{JSON_{2}} can be clustered under “ dense clusters of obstacles near the agent’s starting point ”. Both scenarios are critical edge-cases so we can feedback that “ dense clusters of obstacles near the agent’s starting point ” reveals a functional gap in the navigation policy of the robotic-agent as shown by the evaluation metric scores output by our Unity-3D simulation with low cumulative reward, long paths, many collisions and multiple timeouts and wrong tile visits. These scenarios reveal a SOTIF trigger condition as listed in Table 3 . We can compare the physical layouts for similarity by extracting both the spatial layout and text descriptions from the JSON. From these pairs, we can find layout patterns that cause the robotic-agent problems, for example, patterns that cause a high number of collision or taking too many steps (stuck) and timing out. Additionally, simulators such as Unity-3D allow us to collect logs of all actions which we can mine to determine the actions that led to the failure. These evaluations provide direct empirical evidence for our GSN claims under PAS 8800 such as solutions (evidence requirements) SN1.2, Sn1.4 to Sn1.7 using the scenarios generated for Sn1.3 as shown in Figure 6 demonstrating that functional gaps {FG} under specific triggering conditions {TC} have been found, tested and catalogued.
paragraphs.zh: Agentic 框架生成的场景文本描述支持主题式分析，从而揭示 SOTIF 触发条件和功能缺口（失效模式的描述），并按描述上的相似性对场景进行分组。 例如，θ J ​ S ​ O ​ N 1 \theta_{JSON_{1}} 和 θ J ​ S ​ O ​ N 2 \theta_{JSON_{2}} 可以被聚类到“智能体起点附近的密集障碍物集群”这一类别中。 这两个场景都是关键的边缘情况，因此我们可以反馈指出：“智能体起点附近的密集障碍物集群”揭示了机器人智能体导航策略中的一个功能缺口，这一点通过我们 Unity-3D 模拟输出的评估指标分数得以证实——累计奖励低、路径长、碰撞频繁、多次超时且错误访问了图块。 这些场景揭示了表 3 中列出的 SOTIF 触发条件。 我们可以通过从 JSON 中提取空间布局和文本描述，来比较物理布局的相似性。 通过这对比，我们可以发现导致机器人智能体出现问题的布局模式，例如那些引发大量碰撞、步数过多（陷入僵局）或超时的模式。 此外，像 Unity-3D 这样的模拟器允许我们收集所有动作的记录，从而通过分析这些记录来确定导致失效的具体动作。 这些评估为我们的 GSN 主张（依据 PAS 8800）提供了直接的实证证据，例如解决方案（证据要求）SN1.2、Sn1.4 至 Sn1.7；其中，为 Sn1.3 生成的场景如图 6 所示，表明在特定触发条件 {TC} 下已发现、测试并记录了功能缺口 {FG}。

paragraphs.en: Smaller LMs are more task-specific so we recommend selecting the correct LM for the job. In this paper, we used a coder LM (qwen3-coder:30b) for generating JSON and a reasoner (nemotron3:33b) for critiquing generated scenarios. As well as task specificity, the smaller LMs have smaller context windows and shorter horizons for tasks. We observed that some generated scenarios contained more than 10 obstacles, as shown in Figure 18 , despite strict specification in the LM prompts for 1-10 obstacles. Rather than adding extra steps to the contextual prompt which can degrade the outputs further as per-step reliability for LMs compounds with step count, this problem will be best handled by an error check in the Pydantic validation step (steps 3 and 8 in Figure 2 ). The software stack can then either: loop back to step 1 and generate a new scenario or randomly select 10 from the 20 obstacles. Thus, for smaller LMs, we recommend guardrails to catch out-of-distribution errors and then to handle them appropriately, such as in the supporting software stack, without adding extra context to the prompt or extra steps to the LM reasoning.
paragraphs.zh: 较小的语言模型更专注于特定任务，因此我们建议根据任务选择正确的语言模型。 在本文中，我们使用了一个编码语言模型（qwen3-coder:30b）来生成 JSON，并使用了一个推理模型（nemotron3:33b）来评估生成的场景。 除了任务特异性之外，较小的语言模型还具有更小的上下文窗口和更短的任务处理范围。 我们观察到，某些生成的场景包含超过 10 个障碍，如第 18 图所示，尽管在语言模型的提示中明确要求了 1-10 个障碍。 与其向上下文提示中添加额外步骤（这可能会进一步降低输出质量，因为语言模型每步的可靠性会随步骤数量而累积下降），最好通过 Pydantic 验证步骤中的错误检查来解决此问题（见第 2 图中的步骤 3 和 8）。 然后，软件堆栈可以选择：返回步骤 1 生成新场景，或从 20 个障碍中随机选择 10 个。 因此，对于较小的语言模型，我们建议设置防护机制来检测分布外错误，并在支持性软件堆栈中适当处理这些错误，而无需向提示添加额外上下文或向语言模型的推理过程增加额外步骤。

paragraphs.en: With respect to our evaluation boundaries, we acknowledge the sim-to-real gap between testing environments such as simulation and the uncertain and unpredictable open-ended operating environments encountered by autonomous systems. Unity-3D is a high fidelity simulator with more realism than many other simulators [ 23 ] but does not create full digital twins (environment facsimile). We have specifically chosen the PPO algorithm to underpin the robotic-agent’s navigation as PPO provides the facility to learn in simulation and then transition to learning in the real-world using transfer learning in conjunction with incremental curriculum learning. Our scenario generation framework can create scenarios for real-world testing as the scenarios can be laid out using the JSON specification in step 10 in Figure 3 . The JSON specification described in section 4.1 is agnostic of the testing platform (simulation or real-world).
paragraphs.zh: 关于我们的评估边界，我们承认模拟环境与自主系统所面临的充满不确定性和不可预测性的开放运行环境之间存在“模拟到现实”的差距。 Unity-3D 是一款高保真度的模拟器，其真实感优于许多其他模拟器 [23]，但它并不会创建完整的数字孪生（环境的精确复制品）。 我们特意选择 PPO 算法作为机器人智能体导航的基础，因为 PPO 支持在模拟环境中学习，并通过迁移学习与增量课程学习相结合的方式，过渡到现实世界中的学习。 我们的场景生成框架可以为现实世界的测试创建场景，因为这些场景可以根据图 3 中步骤 10 的 JSON 规范进行布局。 第 4.1 节中描述的 JSON 规范与测试平台（模拟环境或现实世界）无关。

paragraphs.en: When generating edge cases for scenario-based testing, we have to consider the coverage of the scenarios produced (see section 4 ). There is no absolute coverage metric for our framework as the aim of the framework is to uncover unsafe unknown scenarios. The framework currently outputs a broad range of evaluation metrics for each scenario. If we consider the inter-quartile ranges for metrics such as ideal path length and actual path length, the spread of success scores (over 50 repetitious) and couple this with visual inspection of scenarios running in Unity-3D then we can assess the range of scenarios produced. We can mitigate the likelihood of scenario repetition by including other LMs for generating scenarios. Our framework is LM-agnostic through using AI Suite, standardised contextual prompts and knowledge bases, and schema-specified JSON interfaces. We can easily swap LMs. We can even swap LMs during the scenario generation process so we generate a set of scenarios with one LM, and then switch to other LM(s) to generate further scenarios. This should improve the coverage by exploiting the slight variations in LM training and architecture which should increase the variety of generated outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 在为基于场景的测试生成边缘情况时，我们必须考虑所生成场景的覆盖范围（参见第 4 节）。 我们的框架没有绝对的覆盖度指标，因为其目标是发现不安全且未知的场景。 该框架目前为每个场景输出多种评估指标。 如果我们考察理想路径长度和实际路径长度等指标的四分位距，分析成功分数的分布情况（超过 50 次重复测试），并结合对 Unity-3D 中运行场景的视觉检查，我们就能评估所生成场景的范围。 通过引入其他语言模型来生成场景，我们可以降低场景重复出现的可能性。 我们的框架通过使用 AI Suite、标准化的上下文提示和知识库以及模式指定的 JSON 接口，实现了与具体语言模型无关的特性。我们可以轻松更换语言模型。 我们甚至可以在场景生成过程中切换语言模型：先用一个语言模型生成一组场景，然后切换到其他语言模型以生成更多场景。 这种做法应能通过利用语言模型在训练和架构上的细微差异来改善覆盖范围，从而提升生成结果的多样性。

paragraphs.en: Developing and operating autonomous systems in the real world, in particular for safety-critical domains, requires us to verify and validate our claim that the system is acceptably safe across its operational design domain. A significant challenge is not arguing the system’s safety in standard operating contexts but rather arguing that the system remains acceptably safe in rare and complex edge cases (the tail of the distribution). For example, identifying whether particular spatial layouts of the environment cause the system’s navigation stack to fail, i.e., identifying if there is a functional gap in the navigation algorithm with respect to the specific operating context, and what the triggering condition is for any gap. We can then improve the robustness of the AI model used for navigation or incorporate failsafe run-time mitigations to handle these edge case situations.
paragraphs.zh: 在现实世界中开发和运行自主系统，尤其是在安全至上的领域，要求我们必须验证并证实我们的主张：该系统在其整个运行设计域内都是可接受的安全的。 一个重大挑战并非论证系统在标准运行环境下的安全性，而是论证该系统在罕见且复杂的边缘情况（分布的尾部）中仍能保持可接受的安全性。 例如，确定环境中特定的空间布局是否会导致系统的导航堆栈失效，即识别导航算法在特定运行环境下是否存在功能缺口，以及任何功能缺口的触发条件是什么。 然后，我们可以改进用于导航的人工智能模型的鲁棒性，或引入运行时故障安全缓解措施来处理这些边缘情况。

sents.en: Developing and operating autonomous systems in the real world, in particular for safety-critical domains, requires us to verify and validate our claim that the system is acceptably safe across its operational design domain.
sents.zh: 在现实世界中开发和运行自主系统，尤其是在安全至上的领域，要求我们必须验证并证实我们的主张：该系统在其整个运行设计域内都是可接受的安全的。

sents.en: A significant challenge is not arguing the system’s safety in standard operating contexts but rather arguing that the system remains acceptably safe in rare and complex edge cases (the tail of the distribution).
sents.zh: 一个重大挑战并非论证系统在标准运行环境下的安全性，而是论证该系统在罕见且复杂的边缘情况（分布的尾部）中仍能保持可接受的安全性。

sents.en: For example, identifying whether particular spatial layouts of the environment cause the system’s navigation stack to fail, i.e., identifying if there is a functional gap in the navigation algorithm with respect to the specific operating context, and what the triggering condition is for any gap.
sents.zh: 例如，确定环境中特定的空间布局是否会导致系统的导航堆栈失效，即识别导航算法在特定运行环境下是否存在功能缺口，以及任何功能缺口的触发条件是什么。

sents.en: We can then improve the robustness of the AI model used for navigation or incorporate failsafe run-time mitigations to handle these edge case situations.
sents.zh: 然后，我们可以改进用于导航的人工智能模型的鲁棒性，或引入运行时故障安全缓解措施来处理这些边缘情况。

paragraphs.en: Generating scenarios for testing by hand is infeasible due to the time required, and random generation cannot target edge cases. Other approaches such as formal modelling, RL or evolutionary algorithms for targeted scenario generation are computationally expensive. Current LLM and agentic frameworks do not target edge cases, require prior knowledge of functional gaps or require human-in-the-loop prompting and verification of scenarios. Our closed-loop local agentic AI platform coupled with a JSON spatial schema interface and run-time evaluation in simulation provides a flexible, low-cost framework for generating edge case scenarios and the associated safety case evidence ( E S ​ i ​ m E_{Sim} ). This feeds directly into goal structuring notation (GSN) to help us meet the requirements of safety assurance regulations such as ISO 21448 (SOTIF) and PAS 8800 for autonomous systems.
paragraphs.zh: 手动生成测试场景因耗时过长而不可行，且随机生成无法针对边缘情况。 其他方法（如形式化建模、强化学习或用于目标场景生成的进化算法）在计算上成本高昂。 当前的 LLM 和智能体框架并未针对边缘情况，需要预先了解功能缺口，或者需要人工介入提示和验证场景。 我们的闭环本地智能体 AI 平台，结合 JSON 空间模式接口和模拟中的运行时评估，为生成边缘情况场景及相关的案例证据（E S ​ i ​ m E_{Sim}）提供了一个灵活且低成本的方法。 这能直接输入目标结构化表示法（GSN），帮助我们满足 ISO 21448（SOTIF）和 PAS 8800 等针对自主系统的安全保障法规要求。

paragraphs.en: Running our agentic framework with local language models (LMs) avoids transmission latency, cloud costs, service outages and privacy issues. This makes safety assurance, specifically targeted scenario-based testing and functional gap discovery, accessible and secure on standard hardware. The agentic framework uses standardised contextual prompts to create an LM-agnostic loop for edge case generation. It translates natural language specifications in the operational design domain (ODD) of the autonomous system into targeted spatial layouts specified using lightweight text-based JSON schemas. These JSON specifications run in a simulator which outputs JSON evaluation metrics. Here we used the high fidelity simulation of Unity-3D but our framework and JSON spatial layout (simulator input) and evaluation metrics (simulator output) schemas are independent of the simulator used. The evaluation metrics refine and iteratively improve the scenario generation in our closed-loop approach. The entire closed-loop, from ODD description and requirement parsing, through JSON-encoded scenario generation, simulation, evaluation and feedback, runs self-contained on a standard laptop.
paragraphs.zh: 使用本地语言模型（LM）运行我们的智能体框架，可避免传输延迟、云成本、服务中断和隐私问题。 这使得安全性保障——特别是针对特定场景的测试和功能缺口发现——能够在标准硬件上以安全且易于使用的方式实现。 该智能体框架采用标准化的上下文提示，创建一个与具体语言模型无关的循环，用于生成边缘情况。 它将自主系统运行设计域（ODD）中的自然语言规范，转换为通过轻量级文本型 JSON 模式指定的目标空间布局。 这些 JSON 规范在模拟器中运行，并输出 JSON 评估指标。 在此我们使用了 Unity-3D 的高保真模拟，但我们的框架、JSON 空间布局（模拟器输入）和评估指标（模拟器输出）模式均与所用模拟器无关。 评估指标能够优化并迭代改进我们闭环方法中的场景生成过程。 整个闭环流程——从 ODD 描述和需求解析，到 JSON 编码的场景生成、模拟、评估和反馈——均可在标准笔记本电脑上独立运行。

paragraphs.en: ISO 21448 SOTIF mandates that we systematically search for and identify triggering conditions and demonstrate that our system operates within defined safety boundaries and meets its safety goals. When our framework generates a JSON-encoded scenario that causes the robot navigation to violate safety boundaries, such as becoming stuck or not maintaining safe separation from an obstacle, an ISO 21448 area 3 (unknown/unsafe) scenario is identified and converted to area 2 (known/unsafe). The JSON specification coupled with the evaluation metrics serves as a reproducible artefact. LMs are able to generate rich text descriptions of the scenarios such as those shown in Section 6 . By grouping scenarios using the evaluation metrics which point to functional gaps (such as grouping scenarios with high numbers of collisions or scenarios where the robotic-agent repeatedly became stuck and timed out), we can perform a thematic-type analysis of the text descriptions in the cluster to find common themes. These themes highlight the specific triggering condition, T ​ C TC and we can relate T ​ C → F ​ G TC\to FG . This helps to generate verifiable and traceable empirical evidence that functional gaps under specific triggering conditions have been identified and catalogued and provides human-readable analyses of these gaps for safety engineers to improve training of the RL policy or create run-time failsafe mitigations for the robotic-agent.
paragraphs.zh: ISO 21448 SOTIF 要求我们系统地搜索并识别触发条件，同时证明我们的系统在定义的安全边界内运行，并满足其安全目标。 当我们的框架生成一个以 JSON 编码的场景，导致机器人导航违反安全边界（例如卡住或未能与障碍物保持安全距离）时，该场景会被识别为 ISO 21448 的领域 3（未知/不安全），并转换为领域 2（已知/不安全）。 JSON 规范与评估指标相结合，构成了一个可重复生成的产物。 LMs 能够生成丰富的场景文本描述，例如第 6 节中展示的那些描述。 通过利用评估指标对场景进行分组——这些指标指向功能缺口（例如，将碰撞次数较多的场景，或机器人智能体反复卡住并超时的情景归为一组）——我们便可以对簇中的文本描述进行主题式分析，以发现共同的主题。 这些主题突出了特定的触发条件 T ​ C TC，并且我们可以将其关联到 T ​ C → F ​ G TC\to FG 。 这有助于生成可验证且可追溯的经验性证据，证明在特定触发条件下存在的功能缺口已被识别并记录；同时，它也为安全工程师提供了对这些缺口的可读性分析，以便改进强化学习策略的训练，或为机器人智能体创建运行时故障安全缓解措施。

paragraphs.en: The scenario-based testing with our agentic framework has revealed functional gaps in the RL navigation policy. For example, the robotic-agent does not know if it is terminally stuck (boxed in). It will either try and get out until it times out (max steps reached) or barge an obstacle out of the way. To improve the post-hoc investigations, we will analyse the set of evaluation metrics output during simulation or real-word testing to determine the best metrics to capture the quality of scenarios and for supporting the evidence gathering process for safety assurance. We can also use the generated scenarios in RL curriculum learning to improve the RL model’s robustness and then retest the updated RL policy using these edge cases and new edge cases to determine if the functional gaps have been fixed. This will help to show that we have reduced the robotic-agent’s risk to be as low as reasonably practicable and that it meets its allocated safety requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 使用我们的智能体框架进行的场景化测试揭示了强化学习导航策略中存在的功能漏洞。 例如，机器人智能体无法判断自己是否已陷入死局（被完全包围）。 它要么会不断尝试脱困直到超时（达到最大步数），要么会强行推开障碍物以开辟道路。 为了改进事后分析，我们将对模拟或真实世界测试期间输出的评估指标集合进行分析，以确定最能反映场景质量并支持安全验证证据收集过程的指标。 我们还可以将生成的场景用于强化学习课程学习，以提升强化学习模型的鲁棒性，然后使用这些边界案例和新发现的边界案例重新测试更新后的强化学习策略，以判断功能漏洞是否已得到修复。 这将有助于证明我们已将机器人智能体的风险降低至合理可行的最低水平，并确保其满足既定的安全要求。

paragraphs.en: Simulators such as Unity-3D produce replay logs that log actions taken and the environment’s state. We did not collect the logs here due to disk space limitations as they are very large. However, in future work, collecting the logs will provide forensic information for investigating failures such as collisions, we can investigate the robotic-agent’s states, the environment’s states and the actions taken prior to a collision and then use this with the thematic-style analyses (section 7 ) to provide evidence of what went wrong and why.

sents.zh: 此外，Unity-3D Sorter 环境专注于在静态障碍物之间导航并访问静态路径点（方格）。

sents.en: Future development will extend our framework to environments with dynamic obstacles and moveable waypoints.
sents.zh: 未来的开发将把我们的框架扩展到包含动态障碍物和可移动路径点的环境。

sents.en: This will require augmenting the JSON schema to support dynamic trajectory specification.
sents.zh: 这将需要扩展 JSON 模式以支持动态轨迹的指定。

sents.en: The agentic framework can then generate reactive, moving hazards alongside static layouts.
sents.zh: 这样，智能体框架就能生成与静态布局相结合的动态、可移动的障碍。

paragraphs.en: We will also investigate transferring the generated JSON layouts to physical hardware-in-the-loop testbeds, whether the JSON schema needs augmenting for this task and whether we can overcome the sim-to-real gap.
paragraphs.zh: 我们还将研究如何将生成的 JSON 布局迁移到物理硬件在环测试平台，探究该任务是否需要增强 JSON 模式，以及我们能否跨越仿真到现实的鸿沟。
